translations.idiomatic: The Daoist nun Li Xuanzhen was the great-great-granddaughter of Prince Zhen of Yue.

sentences.zh: 曾祖珍子，越王張六男也。

translations.literal: Her great-grandfather Zhenzi was the sixth son of Prince Zhen of Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Her great-grandfather Zhenzi was the sixth son of Prince Zhen of Yue.

sentences.zh: 先天中得罪，配流嶺南。

translations.literal: During the Xiantian era he offended and was banished to Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xiantian reign he offended and was banished to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 玄真祖、父，皆亡歿於嶺外。

translations.literal: Xuanzhen's grandfather and father both died in the regions beyond the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzhen's grandfather and father both died in the far south.

sentences.zh: 雖曾經恩赦，而未昭雪。

translations.literal: Though they had once received amnesty, their names were not yet cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Though amnesty had been granted, their names had not yet been cleared.

sentences.zh: 玄真進狀曰：「去開成三年十二月內得嶺南節度使盧鈞出俸錢接措，哀妾三代旅櫬暴露，各在一方，特與發遣，歸就大塋合祔。

translations.literal: Xuanzhen submitted a petition stating, "Within the twelfth month of the third year of Kaicheng, receiving support from Military Governor Lu Jun of Lingnan from his salary funds, grieving that my family's three generations of traveling coffins lie exposed, each in a different place, I specially arranged their dispatch to return to the great tomb for joint burial."
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzhen submitted a petition stating, "In the twelfth month of the third year of Kaicheng, with funds provided by Military Governor Lu Jun of Lingnan from his salary, grieving that my family's coffins from three generations lie exposed in different places, I have arranged for them to be brought home for burial in the ancestral tomb."

sentences.zh: 今護四喪，已到長樂旅店權下，未委故越王墳所在，伏乞天恩，允妾所奏，許歸大塋。

translations.literal: "Now escorting four coffins, I have reached Chang'an and temporarily lodged at an inn; I do not know the location of the former Prince of Yue's tomb; I humbly beg Heaven's grace to grant my petition and permit return to the great tomb."
translations.idiomatic: "I am now escorting four coffins and have reached Chang'an, lodging temporarily at an inn; I do not know where the tomb of the former Prince of Yue lies; I humbly beg Your Majesty to grant my petition and permit burial in the ancestral tomb."

sentences.zh: 妾年已六十三，孤露家貧，更無依倚。

translations.literal: "I am already sixty-three, orphaned and exposed, my household poor, with no further support."
translations.idiomatic: "I am sixty-three years old, orphaned and destitute, with no one left to rely upon."

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「越王事跡，國史著明，枉陷非辜，尋已洗雪。

translations.literal: An edict stated, "The deeds of the Prince of Yue are clearly recorded in the dynastic history; wrongly implicated without guilt, his name was soon cleared."
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated, "The deeds of the Prince of Yue are clearly recorded in the dynastic histories; wrongly implicated without guilt, his name was long since cleared."

sentences.zh: 其珍子他事配流，數代漂零，不還京國。

translations.literal: "Zhenzi was banished for another affair; for generations they drifted in exile, not returning to the capital."
translations.idiomatic: "Zhenzi was banished for another offense; for generations the family drifted in exile, never returning to the capital."

sentences.zh: 玄真弱女，孝節卓然，啟護四喪，綿歷萬里；

translations.literal: "Xuanzhen, a frail woman, displays outstanding filial constancy, undertaking to escort four coffins across ten thousand li;"
translations.idiomatic: "Xuanzhen, a frail woman, displays outstanding filial devotion, escorting four coffins across ten thousand li;"

sentences.zh: 況是近族，必可加恩。

translations.literal: "moreover as near kin, favor must surely be extended."
translations.idiomatic: "moreover, as near kin, she surely deserves special favor."

sentences.zh: 行路猶或嗟稱，朝廷固須恤助。

translations.literal: "Travelers on the road still sigh in praise; the court must certainly show compassion and aid."
translations.idiomatic: "Travelers on the road still sigh in admiration; the court must show compassion and aid."

sentences.zh: 委宗正寺、京兆府與訪越王墳墓報知。

translations.literal: "Commission the Court of the Imperial Clan and the Metropolitan Prefecture to seek out the Prince of Yue's tomb and report."
translations.idiomatic: "Commission the Court of the Imperial Clan and the Metropolitan Prefecture to locate the Prince of Yue's tomb and report back."

sentences.zh: 如不是陪陵，任祔塋次卜葬。

translations.literal: "If it is not an attendant tomb, permit burial in the secondary plot according to divination."
translations.idiomatic: "If it is not an attendant tomb, permit burial in the secondary plot as divination directs."

sentences.zh: 其葬事仍令京兆府接措，必使備禮。

translations.literal: "The burial affairs shall still be handled by the Metropolitan Prefecture, ensuring full ritual."
translations.idiomatic: "The Metropolitan Prefecture shall handle the burial and ensure full ceremony."

sentences.zh: 葬畢，玄真如願住京城，便配咸宜觀安置。」

translations.literal: "When the burial is complete, if Xuanzhen wishes to dwell in the capital, assign her residence at Xianyi Abbey."
translations.idiomatic: "When the burial is complete, if Xuanzhen wishes to remain in the capital, assign her residence at Xianyi Abbey."

sentences.zh: 孝女王和子者，徐州人。

translations.literal: The filial daughter Wang Hezi was a native of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The filial daughter Wang Hezi was a native of Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 其父及兄為防秋卒，戍涇州。

translations.literal: Her father and elder brother were autumn-defense soldiers garrisoned at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Her father and elder brother were frontier-defense soldiers garrisoned at Jing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元和中，吐蕃寇邊，父兄戰死，無子，母先亡。

translations.literal: During the Yuanhe era the Tibetans raided the border; her father and brother died in battle; there were no sons; her mother had died earlier.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanhe reign the Tibetans raided the frontier; her father and brother died in battle; there were no sons; her mother had died earlier.

sentences.zh: 和子時年十七，聞父兄歿於邊上，被髮徒跣缞裳，獨往涇州。

translations.literal: Hezi was then seventeen; hearing her father and brother had died on the frontier, with hair unbound and barefoot in mourning garments she went alone to Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hezi was seventeen; hearing that her father and brother had died on the frontier, she went alone to Jing Prefecture with hair unbound, barefoot, in mourning garments.

sentences.zh: 行丐取父兄之喪，歸徐營葬。

translations.literal: Traveling as a beggar she retrieved her father and brother's remains, returned to Xu, and arranged burial.
translations.idiomatic: Begging along the way, she retrieved her father and brother's remains, returned to Xu Prefecture, and gave them proper burial.

sentences.zh: 手植松柏，剪發壞形，廬於墓所。

translations.literal: She planted pine and cypress with her own hands, cut her hair and disfigured her form, and dwelt in a hut at the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: She planted pine and cypress with her own hands, cut her hair and disfigured her appearance, and lived in a mourning hut beside the tomb.

sentences.zh: 節度使王智興以狀聞，詔旌表之。

translations.literal: Military Governor Wang Zhixing reported the circumstances and an edict honored her household.
translations.idiomatic: Military Governor Wang Zhixing reported her deeds, and an edict honored her household.

sentences.zh: 又大中五年，兗州瑕丘縣人鄭神佐女，年二十四，先許適馳雄牙官李玄慶。

translations.literal: Also in the fifth year of Dazhong, the daughter of Zheng Shenzuo of Xiqiu County in Yanzhou, aged twenty-four, had been betrothed to Li Xuanqing, an officer of the Chixiong garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Also in the fifth year of Dazhong, the daughter of Zheng Shenzuo of Xiqiu County in Yan Prefecture, aged twenty-four, had been betrothed to Li Xuanqing, an officer of the Chixiong garrison.

sentences.zh: 神佐亦為官健，戍慶州。

translations.literal: Shenzuo also served as a government soldier garrisoned at Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shenzuo also served as a government soldier garrisoned at Qing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時党項叛，神佐戰死，其母先亡，無子。

translations.literal: At the time the Tangut rebelled; Shenzuo died in battle; his mother had died earlier; there were no sons.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tangut rebelled, Shenzuo died in battle; his mother had died earlier, and there were no sons.

sentences.zh: 女以父戰歿邊城，無由得還，乃剪發壞形，自往慶州護父喪還，至瑕丘縣進賢鄉馬青村，與母合葬。

translations.literal: The daughter, because her father had died in battle at the border fortress with no means of return, cut her hair and disfigured her form, went herself to Qingzhou to escort her father's remains home, reaching Maqing Village in Jinxian Township of Xiqiu County, and buried him together with her mother.
translations.idiomatic: Because her father had died in battle at a distant fortress with no means of bringing his body home, the daughter cut her hair and disfigured her appearance, traveled alone to Qing Prefecture to escort her father's remains home, and buried him beside her mother in Maqing Village, Jinxian Township, Xiqiu County.

sentences.zh: 便廬於墳所，手植松檜，誓不適人。

translations.literal: She then dwelt in a hut at the grave, planted pine and cypress with her own hands, and vowed never to marry.
translations.idiomatic: She then lived in a mourning hut beside the grave, planted pine and cypress with her own hands, and vowed never to marry.

sentences.zh: 節度使蕭椒以狀奏之曰：「伏以閭裏之中，罕知禮教，女子之性，尤昧義方。

translations.literal: Military Governor Xiao Jiao memorialized in a report, "I humbly observe that among village neighborhoods, ritual instruction is rarely known; the nature of women especially lacks understanding of righteousness."
translations.idiomatic: Military Governor Xiao Jiao memorialized, "I humbly observe that in village neighborhoods, ritual instruction is rarely known, and women especially lack understanding of righteousness."

sentences.zh: 鄭氏女痛結窮泉，哀深《陟岵》，投身沙磧，歸父遺骸，遠自邊陲，得還閭裏。

translations.literal: "The daughter of the Zheng clan, grief bound to the deep springs, sorrow deep as the 'Ascending the Mound,' cast herself into sandy wastes to return her father's remains, coming from far borderlands back to her native village."
translations.idiomatic: "The daughter of the Zheng clan, her grief reaching to the underworld, her sorrow as deep as the 'Ascending the Mound,' braved the desert wastes to bring her father's remains home from the distant frontier to her native village."

sentences.zh: 感《蓼莪》以積恨，守丘墓以誓心。

translations.literal: "Moved by the 'Polygala' she accumulated bitter grief; guarding the mound and tomb she pledged her heart."
translations.idiomatic: "Moved by the 'Polygala,' she nursed bitter grief; guarding the tomb mound, she pledged her heart."

sentences.zh: 克彰孝理之仁，足厲貞方之節。

translations.literal: "She fully displayed the benevolence of filial principle and sufficiently inspired the constancy of chaste conduct."
translations.idiomatic: "She fully displayed the benevolence of filial devotion and amply exemplified the constancy of chaste conduct."

sentences.zh: 」詔旌表門閭。

translations.literal: An edict honored her household gate.
translations.idiomatic: An edict honored her household.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：政教隆平，男忠女貞。

translations.literal: The encomium states: When government and instruction flourish in peace, men are loyal and women chaste.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium states: When government and instruction flourish in peace, men are loyal and women constant.

sentences.zh: 禮以自防，義不茍生。

translations.literal: Through ritual they guard themselves; through righteousness they do not cling to life in degradation.
translations.idiomatic: Through ritual they guard themselves; through righteousness they refuse to live in shame.

sentences.zh: 彤管有煒，蘭閨振聲。

translations.literal: The red brush shines bright; orchid chambers resound with fame.
translations.idiomatic: The historian's red brush shines bright; women's chambers resound with fame.

sentences.zh: 《關雎》合《雅》，始號文明。

translations.literal: When 'Guan Ju' harmonizes with the 'Ya' hymns, civilization is first proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: When 'Guan Ju' harmonizes with the 'Ya' hymns, civilization is first proclaimed.
